recommended_when: Regular weekday care; standard hours; structured setting; siblings may attend together; suitable supports confirmed
not_recommended_when: Required hours outside provider schedule; required accommodations unavailable; excessive commute; caregiver rejects centre care
notes: Default recommendation only when all hard constraints are met

recommended_when: Caregiver is open to home care; smaller setting or neighbourhood proximity preferred; suitable licensed option is available
not_recommended_when: Caregiver rejects home care; licensing or qualifications unclear; schedule/location mismatch
notes: May be useful during centre waitlists

recommended_when: Caregiver explicitly accepts this option and understands the status; no regulated option meets needs
not_recommended_when: Caregiver requires regulated care; registration/status is unclear; safety information is missing
notes: Always lower confidence and requires explicit caregiver review

recommended_when: Caregiver has employer access; location and work schedule align; child is eligible
not_recommended_when: No employer affiliation; hours or age rules do not fit

recommended_when: Caregiver or household has eligible campus affiliation; schedule and child age align
not_recommended_when: No affiliation or eligibility; hours do not fit

recommended_when: Child is school-aged; program serves the child's school; before/after-school hours meet need
not_recommended_when: Infant/toddler/preschool child; wrong school; hours insufficient

recommended_when: Individualized support, irregular/extended hours, language familiarity or higher-touch care is required and affordable
not_recommended_when: Caregiver rejects in-home care; cost is unaffordable; standard care fully meets needs
notes: Includes nanny, au pair and babysitter variants

recommended_when: Trusted relative is available, willing and consistent; irregular hours or blended care is needed
not_recommended_when: Caregiver has not identified this as an option; relative is unavailable or unreliable
notes: May be part of a blended plan
